diaspora_bullets: A first-generation immigrant from India representing the Columbus area
An Indian American physician in the Ohio House since 2023
hook_line: ANITA SOMANI WINS THIRD OHIO HOUSE TERM

hook_stat.sub: Vote share for Anita Somani in District 8

news_summary: Dr Anita Somani, an Indian American obstetrician-gynecologist, won re-election to the Ohio House of Representatives with 70.79% of the vote, defeating Republican Kelly Hunter-Kalagidis by 20,738 votes in District 8.
payoff: Her new two-year term begins in January 2027.
